description: This source file defines the AuthRepository class responsible for managing authentication workflows in a Flutter/Dart project. It handles login, logout, and retrieval of the current user by interacting with local database sources, secure preferences, and network API clients. It encapsulates operations related to user authentication states and local cache management.

classes.name: AuthRepository
classes.description: A class that manages user authentication processes such as login, logout, and fetching current user data, integrating local storage and network sources.

methods.name: AuthRepository
methods.description: Constructor initializing the AuthRepository with an optional AttendanceDatabaseSource dependency.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs user login with studentId and password, saves received token, and stores user info locally.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Clears the authentication token and user data from local storage and central token management.

methods.name: getCurrentUser
methods.description: Retrieves the current user from local database storage if available.
